Container.Name: imessage-archive
Container.Overview: Back up a trusted, unlocked iPhone with libimobiledevice and browse Messages using imessage-exporter. Includes indexed search, scrollable conversation parts, HTML/text/CSV/ZIP exports, and resumable PDF rendering with image quality controls and progress. Requires a Linux amd64 host and USB pairing before backup. Privileged mode grants broad host access for USB hotplug: install only on a trusted private server. Encrypted backups are supported, but generated exports are not encrypted. Set a unique administrator password and session secret before use. Scheduled Wi-Fi backup requires an already paired, network-visible device.
Container.Requires: Linux amd64, a data-capable USB cable, an unlocked trusted iPhone, and enough storage for a full iPhone backup plus generated exports. Do not expose the Web UI directly to the internet. Preserve existing mount paths when upgrading.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: iphone ios imessage messages sms backup pdf archive

Config.Name: Exports
Config.Description: HTML, text, media and portable ZIP files. Keep this share private.

Config.Name: USB Bus
Config.Description: USB bus bind mount for device hotplug; privileged mode grants device access.

Config.Name: Read-only username
Config.Description: Optional account that can browse and download only

Config.Name: Read-only password
Config.Description: Leave blank to disable the read-only account

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Paste a value from openssl rand -hex 32; retain it across upgrades.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Use 1 only when the Web UI is served through HTTPS

Config.Name: USB multiplexer
Config.Description: Start the container USB service. Only one usbmuxd should own the phone; do not run competing backup containers.

Config.Name: Conversation part size
Config.Description: Messages per viewer/PDF part; smaller parts reduce browser and PDF memory use.

Config.Name: Image workers
Config.Description: Concurrent PDF image conversions. Higher values need more RAM.

Config.Name: PDF part timeout
Config.Description: Maximum seconds per Chromium render; successful parts are resumable.
